title: Magazine Pocket — Tool Life Expired
description: Tool in magazine slot {val} has exceeded 100% of programmed tool life. Tool will not be called by NC program until life counter is reset.
required_action: Log fault. Monitor parameters. Schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.
escalation_path: If TCS-MN-001 is not addressed (log fault. monitor parameters. schedule inspection at next planned maintenance.), the fault will escalate in this order: SPN-WN-001, then TCS-MD-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
